name: all-MiniLM-L6-v2-code-search-512
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes:
ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.023 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-01-04.

CAVEAT: CodeSearchNet validation set, 2000 samples, and the card does not say which languages the 2000 were drawn from despite listing seven supported. The base column is the true base (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) in the same table, so base-column discipline holds. The gain is large and uniform across five metrics, which is what a task-specific contrastive fine-tune should look like; the risk is that a code-search fine-tune is narrow by construction - this record says nothing about general-purpose embedding quality, and the card publishes no general benchmark.
